tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (6.7:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-concrete
tokens.usage: Mimics poured concrete finish │. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: color-concrete-light
tokens.usage: Creates surface variation │. Used as text on `.footer-section a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-concrete-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-meta`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Provides deep shadow and texture │. Used as text on `body`, `.stat-value`, `h1, h2, h3, h4`. 6.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-steel-blue
tokens.usage: Accents represent structural steel │. Used as text on `.stat-change`, `.btn-tertiary`, `.footer-section a:hover`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo`, `nav a`, `th`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: body

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata, set in uppercase — as `div.card-meta` on the reference page.
